verdict_reason: The one-page listing test moves cleanly into describePaging, but no controller test covers the new POST page handling, and describeRefusalKeepsSearchAndPage is named for a page it never asserts.

todos.issue: The PR adds page handling to the POST route (picker-routes.js:29 postedPickerState reads payload.page; :155 a search resets to FIRST_PAGE), but the shared controller tests never post a page. Nothing proves that a refused save serves the page the trader was on, or that a search goes back to page 1. Removing either line in picker-routes.js leaves every test green. describePaging only drives GET.
todos.fix: Must: the shared controller tests prove a refused save (each save control) posted with page 2 serves page 2 of the same results, and a search posted with page 2 serves page 1; each test fails if its line in picker-routes.js is removed. One way: in describeRefusalKeepsSearchAndPage add an it.each over saveControlsFor asserting result.view.context.picker.page is 2 for { ...savePayload, page: '2', [fieldName]: NOT_IN_THE_BOOK } on a picker with wholeCount > ADDRESSES_A_PAGE, and in describeSearching assert picker.page is 1 for { action: 'search', q: '', page: '2' }.

todos.issue: describeRefusalKeepsSearchAndPage (lines 374 and 573) promises that a refused save keeps the page, but its describe title says only 'a refused save keeps the search' and no test inside it posts or asserts a page. Now that the pickers page their results, the name claims behaviour the group does not test.
todos.fix: Must: the group's name and its describe title both state what its tests prove. One way: add the refused-save page tests from the coverage-gap finding to this group and say 'keeps the search and the page' in its describe title, or, if they go elsewhere, rename it describeRefusalKeepsSearch.
